import base64
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile
import time

def digest(path):
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 with Path(path).open('rb') as f:
  for block in iter(lambda:f.read(16*1024*1024),b''): h.update(block)
 return h.hexdigest()
raw=base64.b64decode('')
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()=='af879208324cefcc61a71f603294d6b7aceaa985673ec904e2904c314819fe0c'
control=Path('/datasets/nuscenes-full/hugsim/iter138_control_20261009')
output=Path('/datasets/nuscenes-full/hugsim/outputs/iter138-20261009')
assert not control.exists() and not output.exists()
control.mkdir();packet=control/'packet';packet.mkdir()
with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(raw)) as archive:
 for member in archive.getmembers():
  p=Path(member.name)
  assert not p.is_absolute() and '..' not in p.parts and (member.isfile() or member.isdir())
 archive.extractall(packet)
sys.path.insert(0,str(packet))
old=packet/'experiments/iter136_hugsim_recoverability_canary'
new=packet/'experiments/iter138_numerical_live_replay'
manifest=json.loads((old/'proof/runtime_v2/runtime_manifest.json').read_text())
start=time.monotonic()
for name,expected in manifest['files'].items():
 p=Path(name);assert not p.is_symlink() and p.is_file() and digest(p)==expected,name
report=dict(source_commit='a25e9f09be2a495893c430a3c62bd2da2f4eef8c',packet_sha256='af879208324cefcc61a71f603294d6b7aceaa985673ec904e2904c314819fe0c',prior_bound_files=len(manifest['files']),prior_validation_seconds=time.monotonic()-start)
from experiments.iter138_numerical_live_replay.instrument import instrument
(control/'iter138_closed_loop.py').write_bytes(instrument((old/'proof/source/HUGSIM/closed_loop.py.txt').read_bytes()))
for name in ['run_episode.py','live_trace.py']:
 shutil.copyfile(new/name,control/name)
client=(old/'proof/runtime_v2/e2e.sh.txt').read_text().replace('i136','i138').replace('iter136','iter138').replace('I136','I138')
(control/'e2e.sh').write_text(client);(control/'e2e.sh').chmod(0o755)
base=(old/'proof/runtime_v2/nuscenes_base.yaml.txt').read_text().replace('iter136_control_20261009_v2','iter138_control_20261009')
(control/'nuscenes_base.yaml').write_text(base)
identity=json.loads((old/'proof/runtime_v2/identity.json.txt').read_text());identity['driver_sha256']=digest(control/'iter138_closed_loop.py')
(control/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
manifest.update(deadline_epoch=1791557470.693633,iteration=138,source_commit='a25e9f09be2a495893c430a3c62bd2da2f4eef8c',controller_mode='numerical')
for p in control.rglob('*'):
 if p.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in p.parts: manifest['files'][str(p)]=digest(p)
(control/'runtime_manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
report.update(manifest=manifest,manifest_sha256=digest(control/'runtime_manifest.json'),generated_driver_sha256=identity['driver_sha256'])
output.mkdir()
print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
